body_html:
The Stream armchair brings clean, contemporary lines to the busiest rooms in your building. Its anatomically contoured polypropylene seat and back support people comfortably through long waits and full training sessions, while the durable, wipe-clean shell stands up to constant use in lobbies, clinics, and meeting spaces. Lightweight and stackable, it lets your team reset a room in minutes.

Features

  • Contoured polypropylene seat and back deliver even, pressure-free support
  • Tough, easy-to-clean shell built for high-traffic guest and waiting areas
  • Stacks up to 5 high on the floor and 15 high on an optional dolly for quick room turnover
  • Color-matched arms, glides, and under-seat shroud for a finished, cohesive look
  • Standard non-marking nylon bullet glides; carpet and hard-floor casters available
  • Choice of 14 designer shell colours and 3 frame finishes (Black, Chrome, Tungsten)

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 24"W x 25"D x 33.25"H, with an 18"W x 18"D seat at 17" high. The chair is part of Global Furniture Group's Stream multi-purpose series, made in Canada and backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and structural components, including the polypropylene seat and back.

Office Central is a family-owned dealer (since 1964) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario school boards, hospitals, and municipalities can purchase without an open tender. To see this chair rendered in your preferred colours at no charge, Request a Quote or Call 1-800-835-9565.
